svg.title: npm run demo: the wrong fix is blocked, the right fix passes
svg.text: examples/caught-wrong-fix (abridged output of npm run demo)

g.text: The report: "the modal is cut off" (issue #7). Real cause: too NARROW.
PR 1 - the WRONG fix: reads the report as a height clip, caps the height,
and carries a test that proves the height cap. Everything looks green.
receipts: BLOCK - weak receipt: the test already PASSES on the base commit,
so it does not prove it reproduced the reported symptom (G0/G1). Make it
assert the actual symptom, tag the PR honestly, or mark it work-type: refactor.
- G14 receipt strength: 2/2 mutant(s) SURVIVED - the receipt stayed green while
the changed code was deliberately broken (modal.js:1 (number +1), (number -1)).
PR 2 - the RIGHT fix: reproduces the reporter's symptom first (G0). The test
pins the EXACT width - red on the bug, green on the fix - and survives G14.
receipts: PASS - receipt verified: red on base, green on fix - the symptom is
>>> Red on base (the symptom reproduced), green on head (the symptom gone),
>>> full suite green (G9). That is a receipt. That is the whole product.
